notes.title: July 7 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Copywriting revisions in English, Russian, and Japanese have been completed.

2. Three image detail adjustments.

3. Added back button at the end of each story.

notes.title: July 5 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. The description of the game features of Whisper Books has been further strengthened.

2. Most of the copywriting of the "Choice Point" has been improved to make the content expression more immersive, and at the same time, the problem of "some content is like a preaching" criticized by players has been revised.
（The Chinese part of this modification has been completed. English, Japanese and Russian translations will be in place within 2 days.）

Developer: I hope you will continue to support our game. We will humbly listen to comments and work hard to improve the shortcomings of the first release.
